annotations.title: Where to file Form 2553 (fax and address)

description: The IRS service center, fax number and mailing address for Form 2553 for a business in a given US state, DC or territory: the address the IRS instructions print, plus the street address of the same center that USPS Certified Mail can validate.

state.description: US state, DC or territory where the business is located, as a two-letter code or name, e.g. 'NY' or 'Texas'.
